newsitem.title: FRANCE: French film, theatre actress Casares dies.
newsitem.headline: French film, theatre actress Casares dies.

text.p: Spanish-born French actress Maria Casares died on Friday after a film and stage career spanning half a century, the culture ministry said.
Casares died at her home in La Vergne, in the western region of Charente, a day after her 74th birthday.

"She lit the whole history of contemporary theatre through her immense, lyrical, tragic and generous presence," Culture Minister Philippe Douste-Blazy said, hailing her as "a grand lady of European entertainment".
She is best remembered for starring in the film "Les Enfants du Paradis" (Children of Paradise) directed by Marcel Carne who died earlier this month. She also starred in Jean Cocteau's "Orphee".
But the theatre was her passion. A member of the Comedie Francaise theatre company, she won France's National Theatre Prize at 68.

Born Maria Casares Quiroga, the daughter of a senior Spanish Republic government official, she volunteered as a nurse in the Spanish civil war and sought asylum in France after the troops of General Francisco Franco crushed the short-lived Republic.
